data.name: Gourav Nagar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Gourav Nagar has made a big mark in cricket. With 8 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 17*, with an average of 11.25 and a quick strike rate of 91.84. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 13.0 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 7.54. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
